related.title: WireGuard：密鑰路由、AllowedIPs 與封包預算
related.titleEn: WireGuard: cryptokey routing, AllowedIPs and packet budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50與20分鐘可重算，錯誤principal和主機身分皆拒絕；稽核檔不包含私鑰或agent socket。 交付五案驗證矩陣、憑證序號稽核表與簽發端權限設計。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 50 and 20 minutes, reject wrong principals and host identities, and exclude private keys and agent sockets from audit artifacts. Deliver five validation cases, certificate-serial audit mapping and signer access design.
related.difference: 用兩個離線peer設定表區分外層endpoint、隧道內來源與AllowedIPs；畫出送出路由選擇及收到後的來源範圍驗證。
related.differenceEn: Use two offline peer tables to distinguish outer endpoints, inner source addresses and AllowedIPs; diagram outbound peer selection and inbound source-range validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 登入時剩餘生命=TTL−簽發到使用的延遲；仍需符合principal與主機信任，剩餘時間大於零不是唯一准入條件。 教學憑證TTL60分鐘，簽發至登入延遲10分鐘；時鐘同步且無額外寬限。 60−10=50分鐘可用；TTL縮為30分鐘後剩20分鐘。
封包剩餘預算=路徑MTU−外層IP−UDP−WireGuard資料封裝；此預算尚未扣內層協定與可能填補。 路徑MTU1500位元組；無選項IPv4表頭20、UDP8、資料封裝32位元組。 1500−20−8−32=1440位元組；外層改無擴充IPv6表頭40時剩1420位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining lifetime at login equals TTL minus issuance-to-use delay; principal and host trust must also match, so positive lifetime alone does not authorize access. Teaching TTL is 60 minutes and issuance-to-login delay 10 minutes, with synchronized clocks and no grace interval. 60−10=50 usable minutes; TTL 30 leaves 20 minutes.

Remaining packet budget equals path MTU minus outer IP, UDP and WireGuard data overhead; it is before inner protocols and possible padding. Path MTU is 1500 bytes; option-free IPv4 header is 20, UDP 8 and data encapsulation 32 bytes. 1500−20−8−32=1440 bytes; using a 40-byte IPv6 header without extensions leaves 1420 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MTA-STS 與 TLS-RPT：郵件傳輸加密驗收
related.titleEn: MTA-STS and TLS-RPT: mail-transport encryption acceptance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：50與20分鐘可重算，錯誤principal和主機身分皆拒絕；稽核檔不包含私鑰或agent socket。 交付五案驗證矩陣、憑證序號稽核表與簽發端權限設計。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 50 and 20 minutes, reject wrong principals and host identities, and exclude private keys and agent sockets from audit artifacts. Deliver five validation cases, certificate-serial audit mapping and signer access design.
related.difference: 列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。
related.differenceEn: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 登入時剩餘生命=TTL−簽發到使用的延遲；仍需符合principal與主機信任，剩餘時間大於零不是唯一准入條件。 教學憑證TTL60分鐘，簽發至登入延遲10分鐘；時鐘同步且無額外寬限。 60−10=50分鐘可用；TTL縮為30分鐘後剩20分鐘。
傳輸成功率=成功的報告sessions/報告總sessions；報告涵蓋率需另外追蹤，缺報告不代表成功。 教學日報1000個sessions，其中40失敗；此樣本僅含有回報的寄送端。 (1000−40)/1000×100=96%；同樣1000筆中只剩10失敗時為99%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining lifetime at login equals TTL minus issuance-to-use delay; principal and host trust must also match, so positive lifetime alone does not authorize access. Teaching TTL is 60 minutes and issuance-to-login delay 10 minutes, with synchronized clocks and no grace interval. 60−10=50 usable minutes; TTL 30 leaves 20 minutes.

Transport success rate equals successful reported sessions divided by reported sessions; track reporting coverage separately because missing reports do not prove success. A teaching daily report contains 1000 sessions with 40 failures, covering only reporting senders. (1000−40)/1000×100=96%; with 10 failures among the same 1000 sessions, success is 99%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
